UPDATE bot_state
   SET lease_until = now() + interval '60 seconds',
       updated_at  = now()
 WHERE id = 1
   AND lease_until < now()
RETURNING marker;

UPDATE bot_state
   SET marker      = COALESCE($1::bigint, marker),
       lease_until = now() - interval '1 second',
       updated_at  = now()
 WHERE id = 1;

UPDATE bot_state
   SET lease_until = now() - interval '1 second',
       updated_at  = now()
 WHERE id = 1;
